text:
maria (People Ops): Heads up — after last night's ATS migration a bunch of our embedded interviewer guides (short Loom vids + one-pagers) are showing as blank frames in the candidate view. Seeing this for Cand IDs 2345-2352. Anyone else?
jamie (Recruiter): yep I just clicked through for two candidates, the thumbnail is there but playback area is empty. Tried Chrome + Safari.
rachel (Hiring Manager): same on my side. Was going to prep an onsite and couldn't watch the interviewer walkthrough.
samir (Recruiting Eng): thanks — filing this now. Do we have a reproducible URL or candidate link? can you DM me one?
maria (People Ops): pasted one: https://ats.redwood.example/candidate/2347/overview — embed section shows title "Interviewer guide" but the player area is blank.
samir (Recruiting Eng): looking at network, the embed tries to fetch https://video-cdn.redwood.example/loom/gh-2347 but returns 404. hmmm. That endpoint was moved during migration.
recruiting-bot: deploy:cdn-migration v2 deployed at 1739021200 by infra-bot.
jamie (Recruiter): any ETA? we have interviews scheduled in 2 days and folks rely on the embeds.
samir (Recruiting Eng): quick mitigation: I can flip the ATS UI to show a direct link to the asset (fallback) instead of the inline player. Will take ~30min to patch and test. Anyone object?
maria (People Ops): please do that. Also can we surface a temporary note for interviewers "If player blank, click link" so they don't miss prep.
rachel (Hiring Manager): +1 for a banner. We should also ensure the one-pagers (PDFs) still render — those are critical.
samir (Recruiting Eng): checking PDFs now — they fetch from /assets/pdf/ and those seem fine. Only the loom CDN path broken. Patch plan: 1) add fallback link + banner, 2) add instrumentation to count broken embed hits, 3) follow-up migration fix to restore old CDN paths or update references.
jamie (Recruiter): for instrumentation, can we log candidate_id + interviewer_email? helps ops triage.
samir (Recruiting Eng): yep can capture candidate_id and anonymized interviewer id. Won't log PII.
maria (People Ops): amazing. After patch, can you post in #people-ops so I can message all scheduled interviewers? I'll include a short template we can paste.
samir (Recruiting Eng): patching now. I'll post back with timestamps.
recruiting-bot: incident created: INC-2023-4510 "embedded-player-404-after-cdn-migration" assigned to samir.
samir (Recruiting Eng): rollback option if patch causes regressions: revert cdn-migration or rewrite embed URLs at DB level. I'll avoid DB rewrite unless necessary.
jamie (Recruiter): thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. If you want someone to proof the banner copy ping me.
maria (People Ops): once it's live I'll run a quick email to today's interviewers and add a note to the playbook.
samir (Recruiting Eng): done — banner + fallback link deployed at 1739024662. Monitoring for errors now. Will follow up in 30m with counts.
jamie (Recruiter): verified the fallback link shows and plays for candidate 2347. thanks! :thumbsup:
